findings.failure_path: Let ordered predecessors [A,B,C,D] pollute the victim only when A and D both run. Neither half [A,B] nor [C,D] fails alone, so the rule keeps both. Cutting into smaller chunks or singletons also produces no failing chunk; without testing complements or removing chunks, the procedure cannot reduce to [A,D] and may stall with the entire set. The mirrored playbook recipe and source-register row repeat/overclaim the same behavior.
findings.smallest_fix: Specify order-preserving ddmin in both the entrypoint and playbook: when no subset fails, test ordered complements/removal of each chunk, increase granularity, and stop only at a 1-minimal ordered polluting subsequence. Add the explicit jointly-required two-polluter case to the rule or its validation evidence.

concern_results.conclusion: The defect-diagnosis lens exposes an unclosed two-test-pollution path, while the extraction ledger incorrectly records that class as fixed. The prescribed reduction lacks complement/removal testing, so it is not a complete order-preserving suite reducer.

challenge_focus: Succession focus (chain r4, landing candidate): confirm the six fixes close their classes without new bypasses — single probe-ordering rule (safety filter, discrimination per cost, tie-breakers), order-preserving suite reduction that handles two-test pollution, upstream trace bounded to owned code with contract enforcement at the nearest owned boundary, playbook rows mirroring the entrypoint, process-pack attribution evidence. Prior focus (chain r3): gate-fireability and bypass-by-omission of every new diagnosis rule; data-leak/data-loss paths in instrumentation and evidence handling; contradictions with falsify-first, three-strike, complexity-verdict, and sanitization rules; over-broad absolutes on simple bugs; SKILL.md vs playbook consistency; Sources accuracy.
predecessor_challenge_focuses: Adversarial focus (chain r3, final candidate): gate-fireability and bypass-by-omission of every new diagnosis rule — probe ordering, in-loop hypothesis log, causality-plus-incorrectness fix gate, redacted boundary walk with safe-rerun condition, suite bisection, upstream trace, observe-not-infer, telemetry substitute for irreproducible symptoms, evidence-confined pathspec bisect, and the playbook drift guard; data-leak or data-loss paths in instrumentation and evidence handling; contradictions with the existing falsify-first, three-strike, complexity-verdict, and sanitization rules; over-broad absolutes that cost rounds on simple deterministic bugs; internal consistency between SKILL.md and the playbook table; accuracy of the Sources section against the primary pages named in attribution-evidence.md.
